strings.english: After every morning church event, you receive candles equal to 50% of all sin points earned during the service

strings.spanish: Después de cada evento matutino de la iglesia, recibirás velas equivalentes al 50% de todos los puntos de pecado obtenidos durante el servicio.
strings.chinese: 每天早晨的教堂活动结束后，你将获得相当于礼拜期间获得的所有罪孽点数50%的蜡烛。
strings.translation: 每天早晨的教堂活动结束后，你将获得相当于礼拜期间获得的所有罪孽点数50%的蜡烛。

strings.english: Trade
strings.lookup_english: Trade

strings.english: Allows you to build a trade post, assign a shopkeeper whose greed and shop sins drive prices and stock, the stall opens during the day once stock is ready after assigning staff, one time skip is needed to prepare goods, unlocks Vegetables, Construction, and Pawn Shop modes in the trade post
strings.lookup_english: Allows you to build a trade post, assign a shopkeeper whose greed and shop sins drive prices and stock, the stall opens during the day once stock is ready after assigning staff, one time skip is needed to prepare goods, unlocks Vegetables, Construction, and Pawn Shop modes in the trade post
strings.spanish: Te permite construir un puesto comercial. Asigna un comerciante cuya avaricia y pecados comerciales impulsen los precios y las existencias. El puesto abre durante el día una vez que el stock está listo; después de asignar personal, es necesario un salto temporal para preparar los productos. Desbloquea los modos Verduras, Construcción y Casa de empeño en el puesto comercial.
strings.chinese: 允许你建造交易站。分配一名店主，其贪婪和商店罪孽会影响价格与库存。货摊在货物备好后于白天开门，分配员工后，需要跳过时间一次来准备货物。解锁交易站中的蔬菜、建筑和当铺模式。
strings.translation: 允许你建造交易站。分配一名店主，其贪婪和商店罪孽会影响价格与库存。货摊在货物备好后于白天开门，分配员工后，需要跳过时间一次来准备货物。解锁交易站中的蔬菜、建筑和当铺模式。

strings.english: Urban Planning

strings.english: Unlocks the Village Manager, press V, or open the Village Manager app on the flip phone, to plan the village's bounds and utilities
strings.lookup_english: Unlocks the Village Manager, press V, or open the Village Manager app on the flip phone, to plan the village's bounds and utilities
strings.spanish: Desbloquea el Village Manager. Dale a la V, o abre la app de Village Manager en el móvil para planificar los límites del pueblo y los servicios públicos.
strings.chinese: 解锁村庄管理器：按V键，或在翻盖手机上打开村庄管理器应用，即可规划村庄的边界和公共设施。
strings.translation: 解锁村庄管理器：按V键，或在翻盖手机上打开村庄管理器应用，即可规划村庄的边界和公共设施。

strings.english: The Village Manager is yours, press V to open it
strings.lookup_english: The Village Manager is yours, press V to open it
strings.spanish: El Village Manager es todo tuyo. Pulsa V para abrirlo.
strings.chinese: 村庄管理器归你了，按V键即可打开。
strings.translation: 村庄管理器归你了，按V键即可打开。

strings.english: Watchtower
strings.lookup_english: Watchtower

strings.english: Unlocks the watchtower building, assign watchers by time of day; each active watcher reduces colony faith loss based on their envy (1% reduction per 2 envy points, stacking up to 100%) unlocks privacy laws after sermons
strings.lookup_english: Unlocks the watchtower building, assign watchers by time of day; each active watcher reduces colony faith loss based on their envy (1% reduction per 2 envy points, stacking up to 100%) unlocks privacy laws after sermons
strings.spanish: Desbloquea la torre de vigilancia. Asigna vigilantes por horas del día; cada vigilante activo reduce la pérdida de fe de la colonia en función de su envidia (reducción del 1% por cada 2 puntos de envidia, acumulándose hasta el 100%). Desbloquea las leyes de privacidad tras los sermones.
strings.chinese: 解锁瞭望塔建筑。按一天中的时段分配守望者；每个活跃的守望者根据其嫉妒降低殖民地信仰损失（每2点嫉妒减少1%，最多叠加至100%）。
strings.translation: 解锁瞭望塔建筑。按一天中的时段分配守望者；每个活跃的守望者根据其嫉妒降低殖民地信仰损失（每2点嫉妒减少1%，最多叠加至100%）。

strings.english: Wild Life
strings.lookup_english: Wild Life

strings.english: Allows your sinners to go out briefly and hunt animals bringing back animal origin products like meat, eggs, milk, unlocks the trade post building and the Meat mode in the trade post
strings.lookup_english: Allows your sinners to go out briefly and hunt animals bringing back animal origin products like meat, eggs, milk, unlocks the trade post building and the Meat mode in the trade post
strings.spanish: Permite a tus pecadores salir brevemente y cazar animales, trayendo productos de origen animal como carne, huevos, leche... Desbloquea el puesto comercial y el modo Carne en el puesto comercial.
strings.chinese: 允许你的罪人短暂外出狩猎动物，带回肉类、蛋、奶等动物源产品。解锁交易站建筑以及交易站中的肉类模式。
strings.translation: 允许你的罪人短暂外出狩猎动物，带回肉类、蛋、奶等动物源产品。解锁交易站建筑以及交易站中的肉类模式。

strings.spanish: Desbloquea la capacidad de elegir las horas de trabajo de tus pecadores, leyes salariales y leyes de maternidad tras los sermones.
strings.chinese: 安排罪人如何分配工作与休息的一天。在研究强制劳动和开启法律系统之前必需。
strings.translation: 安排罪人如何分配工作与休息的一天。在研究强制劳动和开启法律系统之前必需。

strings.lookup_english: Unlocks the workbench, Electricity mode, and the first electrical buildings: the utility post and the generator
strings.spanish: Desbloquea la mesa de trabajo, el modo Electricidad y las primeras construcciones eléctricas: el poste de luz y el generador.
strings.chinese: 解锁工作台、电力模式以及首批电力建筑：电线杆和发电机。
strings.translation: 解锁工作台、电力模式以及首批电力建筑：电线杆和发电机。

strings.english: The workbench and Electricity mode are yours

strings.spanish: La mesa de trabajo y el modo Electricidad son todo tuyos.
strings.chinese: 工作台和电力模式都归你了。
